issues.explanation: Evidence S23683-043 places all content for الف-7 (الزامات حفاظت از حریم خصوصی) at printed page 18 (pdf 27). Evidence for الف-8 (S23683-044) begins at printed page 19 (pdf 28). No evidence item shows الف-7 continuing to page 19. The claim «و ۱۹» is unsupported and, given that الف-8 starts at printed 19, misleading.

No evidence item confirms a full-space variant «زپ سا» in the document. T23683-3.1.36 transcribes the entry title as «زپ‌سا» (with ZWNJ) throughout. The printed-inconsistency catalogue I23683-unc3 lists confirmed variants (scatter/gather forms, کلان‌داده/بزرگ‌داده, محاسبات ابری/رایانش ابری, «بدیل») but does not include a ZWNJ-vs-space variant for زپ‌سا.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove «و گاه «زپ سا» با فاصله» from the sentence, or qualify it explicitly as an observation not confirmed in the evidence package.

issues.explanation: Outline evidence O23683-069 transcribes the Annex A heading as «کلان‌داده» (with ZWNJ). I23683-unc3 records the کلان‌داده/بزرگ‌داده inconsistency but does not mention a ZWNJ-vs-full-space variant of «کلان‌داده» in the table of contents specifically. No cited evidence item supports «کلان داده» (space) at that location.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the parenthetical location «(فهرست مندرجات پیوست الف)» for the «کلان داده» variant, or qualify it as unconfirmed by the evidence package.
